nodes.label: ADR 0023: Tenant Usage Snapshots
nodes.rationale: Daily cron at 01:00 UTC writes tenant_usage_snapshots with bounded concurrency (=5) cross-DB fan-out. Counters per tenant per day: member_count, customer_count, appt_count_30d, sales_total_30d_minor, sales_currency, storage_bytes (deferred), ghl_active. UPSERT on (organization_id, snapshot_date) for idempotency. Manual trigger runTenantUsageSnapshotsNow on admin router. Admin UI reads from control-panel only — no fan-out at request time.
alternatives_rejected: Realtime streaming (hot-path side effect on every business write)
On-demand fan-out with KV cache (first uncached request pays fan-out; no history)
Snapshot every N hours (hourly multiplies rows 24x for no business signal)
